tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a directly purchasable product (accessories, water care, outdoor living) to the shopping cart. For variable products pass variation_id. Whirlpools and spas are configured and quoted instead; use open_configurator for those.

variation_id.description: For variable products: the chosen variation_id from get_product_details.variations

tools.name: book_showroom_appointment
tools.description: Open the online appointment booking (Zoho Bookings) of a showroom in this tab. The user completes the booking form.

showroom_name.description: e.g. Senden, Hamburg, München, Nürnberg, Esslingen, Frankfurt

tools.name: calculate_configuration
tools.description: Calculate the total price of a whirlpool/spa configuration without saving. selection maps option group slugs to option slugs (or true for yes/no options) as returned by get_product_details.configurator.groups.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Show the current shopping cart (items, totals) and the cart/checkout links.

tools.name: get_page_context
tools.description: What page is currently open (product, category, page) including product id, price and availability if it is a product page.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Full details of one product: description, technical data, availability with expected date and lead time, configurator option groups with surcharges, price range, showrooms where the model is on display, rating.

product_id.description: WooCommerce product ID (from search_products or page context)

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List product categories with counts and links.

tools.name: list_showrooms
tools.description: List SPA Deluxe showrooms (Ausstellungen) in Germany with address, phone, opening hours, page link and online appointment booking link. Optionally with stock of a given product per showroom.

product_id.description: Optional: show where this model is on display

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate this tab to a spadeluxe.de URL (product, category, showroom, contact page).

tools.name: open_configurator
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the online configurator of a product (or to a saved configuration code).

tools.name: save_configuration
tools.description: Save a configuration and get a shareable configuration code and link that opens the configurator with these options preselected. From there the user can request a binding quote ("Angebot anfordern").

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the SPA Deluxe knowledge articles (Ratgeber/Wissen) about whirlpools, water care, saunas, costs, installation.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the SPA Deluxe catalogue (whirlpools/hot tubs, swim spas, saunas, infrared cabins, outdoor living). Returns products with price, availability, specs (persons, seats, dimensions) and links. Prices of configurable products are base prices; see price_range.

query.description: Free text, model name or SKU, e.g. "J-335", "Whirlpool 6 Personen"

category.description: Category slug: whirlpool, swim-spas, gartensauna, innensauna, infrarotkabinen, lamellendach, outdoor-living, feuerstellen

availability.description: in_stock = sofort lieferbar, incoming = im Zulauf mit Datum, orderable = bestellbar
